get_token: get the Hugging Face authentication token from environment variables, secrets, or config file
get_stored_tokens: retrieve all stored Hugging Face tokens from the INI configuration file as a dictionary
_save_token: save a Hugging Face token with a given name to the stored tokens configuration file
_get_token_by_name: retrieve a specific Hugging Face token by its name from the stored tokens file
_write_secret: write secret content to a file with owner-only permissions on POSIX systems
